title: Submission, Acknowledgement and Claim-Status Follow-Up — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Policy clause.** Every Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is submitted in the payer class's submission format and a 277CA acceptance or rejection is expected within the payer class's acknowledgement period. An accepted claim with no remittance after the first follow-up period is followed up by claim-status inquiry, then every follow-up interval; after the payer class's number of unanswered follow-ups the claim is escalated to the payer's provider representative. Coverage and coordination-of-benefits answers older than the payer class's re-confirmation period must be re-confirmed with the patient before the next claim is submitted, and subscriber data changed by the patient is applied to every open claim of the same payer before resubmission.

**Follow-up timeline (hypothetical, first follow-up at 30 days, interval 15 days, escalation after 3 unanswered)**

| Day after acceptance with no remittance | Action |
|---|---|
| 30 | first claim-status inquiry |
| 45 | second inquiry |
| 60 | third inquiry |
| after the third goes unanswered | escalation to the payer's provider representative |

**Points of judgement**
- Coverage answers dated 400 days ago, under a 365-day re-confirmation period, are re-confirmed with the patient before the next claim goes out.
- A member ID the patient corrects is applied to every open claim of that same payer before any of them is resubmitted.
